residual_findings.title: Served-UI smoke cleanup kills any process on the selected port before proving ownership
residual_findings.note: The smoke script runs lsof -ti tcp:${PORT} and kills all returned PIDs before starting its own daemon. This is low risk in CI because the script normally chooses an ephemeral port, but local runs with NEXUS_DAEMON_PORT set, or an ephemeral-port race, can terminate an unrelated process. Prefer failing fast on occupied port, or only killing a process proven to be a previous Nexus smoke daemon owned by this script/test home.
residual_findings.closure_note: Replaced the lsof kill loop with a port-ownership guard. The script now fails fast when the chosen port is occupied by an unrelated process and only terminates a leftover Nexus smoke daemon whose command line matches this script's binary + 'daemon start --port <port> --foreground'. Added readiness-poll failure when the daemon process exits early, NEXUS42 path override for local testing, and shellcheck-clean loops. Verified with shellcheck, bash -n, a full local smoke run, an occupied-port guard test (unrelated listener preserved), and a stale-smoke-daemon cleanup test.

residual_findings.title: desktop-release.yml signing flow is incomplete (no keychain import, no notarize)
residual_findings.note: desktop-release.yml reads APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY and has a fail-fast check, but the .p12 certificate is never imported to the runner's temporary keychain, so even when the secret is configured, tauri build's codesign invocation cannot find the private key and fails. Also missing: notarize + staple steps, so signed .dmg would still be blocked by macOS Gatekeeper on first open. V1.71 ship is not blocked because the PR-verification workflow (desktop-build.yml) is now unsigned-only (revert of P1 mis-injection). Release artifacts for V1.71 are produced by developer-local signing + manual upload, not via this CI workflow. Full fix: add 'Import signing certificate to temporary keychain' step between 'Require signing identity' and 'Build Tauri desktop bundle', plus a notarize + staple step after dmg creation. Secrets required: APPLE_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64, APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD, APPLE_ID, APPLE_PASSWORD, APPLE_TEAM_ID in addition to APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY.
residual_findings.closure_note: Closed in V1.72 P1: desktop-release.yml now imports the .p12 certificate into a temporary keychain, signs the .app with codesign --options runtime --timestamp --deep, rebuilds the .dmg from the signed .app, submits the .dmg to Apple notarytool with --wait, and staples the notarization ticket. When the five required secrets are absent the workflow emits an unsigned-artifacts notice and succeeds; when only some secrets are present it uploads unsigned artifacts and fails with a list of missing secrets. Updated apps/desktop/SIGNING.md with the secret table and CI flow.

residual_findings.title: Dedupe CI/desktop-build setup steps via composite action
residual_findings.note: ci.yml and desktop-build.yml each re-declare the same monorepo setup boilerplate (checkout, pnpm/action-setup, setup-node, dtolnay/rust-toolchain, Swatinem/rust-cache, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile) in every job. The boilerplate cannot be merged at the workflow level (jobs must run in parallel on independent runners with different OS images), but the setup steps themselves are repeated verbatim ~7 times across the two files, making it tedious to bump action SHAs or pnpm/node versions. Fix: extract a .github/actions/setup-monorepo composite action that takes rust-targets, cache-key, and cache-workspaces as inputs, and have all jobs in both workflows use it. Do NOT attempt to merge jobs or workflows (GitHub Actions jobs are intentionally isolated). Do NOT extract the build/test steps themselves — they vary too much across jobs to share meaningfully.
residual_findings.closure_note: Closed in V1.72 P1: created .github/actions/setup-monorepo/action.yml composite action covering pnpm/action-setup, actions/setup-node (with pnpm cache), optional dtolnay/rust-toolchain (skipped when rust-toolchain input is empty), and pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Updated ci.yml and desktop-build.yml to consume the composite action; both files shrank by ≥20 lines each while preserving matrix behavior and OS coverage. checkout and rust-cache remain workflow-owned (composite action does not include them, per V1.72 §6.8 hard constraint). Note: V1.72 P-last closure prose correction (R-V172P1-QC3-004).

residual_findings.title: Template rollback in strategy.rs uses non-atomic std::fs::write
residual_findings.note: rollback_template_write restores the previous template bytes via std::fs::write after a validation failure, which is non-atomic. A process crash mid-rollback could leave the template truncated while the YAML revision was already restored. Note: the rollback path is only reachable on validation failure (very rare), and the primary write path is now atomic via atomic_write_with_dir_fsync. Cosmetic defence-in-depth for the failure path. R-V171-GREPTILE-POST5. | V1.72 deferred to V1.73 hygiene backlog (plan-id tbd-v1.73-hygiene) per compass §5 V1.73 deferrals table.
